predeclared_model_selection.best_predictive_accuracy: lowest mean pooled raw-pixel validation MSE across matched seeds
predeclared_model_selection.compact_neural: AO-3 is a compact candidate only if it remains on the accuracy/parameter Pareto frontier; report its measured accuracy trade-off without claiming equivalence

AO-1.continuation_rule: fork into a new output directory; resume saved optimizer/RNG state through the 30-epoch maximum; never modify the pilot run

AO-2.continuation_rule: fork into a new output directory; resume saved optimizer/RNG state through the 30-epoch maximum; never modify the pilot run

AO-3.continuation_rule: fork into a new output directory; resume saved optimizer/RNG state through the 30-epoch maximum; never modify the pilot run

split_manifest.eligibility: 60 consecutive annotated frames; outside boxes, malformed boxes, non-positive boxes, and out-of-frame boxes break a track segment; stride 30 within each contiguous valid segment.
split_manifest.fps_basis: IDD-PeD paper reports GoPro Hero 8 at 30 FPS; all selected sets are GoPro annotations.

training_config.data_order: permutation seeded by seed + epoch; matched across model IDs
training_config.secondary_metric_aggregation: macro-video mean reported separately; track-level summaries cluster windows within video and track
